mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-01.stem: HRC and HV values can be compared directly as the same scale without checking the methods.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. HRC and HV are scales for different hardness tests. Do not directly compare numbers without checking methods and conditions.
False. HRC and HV are scales for different hardness tests. Do not directly compare numbers without checking methods and conditions.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-02.stem: This app’s mock exams are independently created and do not reproduce questions that actually appeared in the exam.
reasons: True. The referenced exam overview specifies CBT, with 30 theory true/false questions and 10 practical multiple-choice questions assessing judgment, planning and related skills. Despite the name “practical,” this format is different from operating an actual machine. This app’s mock exams are independently authored, not reproductions of questions that actually appeared.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. The referenced exam overview specifies CBT, with 30 theory true/false questions and 10 practical multiple-choice questions assessing judgment, planning and related skills. Despite the name “practical,” this format is different from operating an actual machine. This app’s mock exams are independently authored, not reproductions of questions that actually appeared.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-03.stem: Do not determine a dimension type merely because one symbol is not visible; also read the target geometry and both ends of the dimension line.
reasons: True. Radius is indicated by R, diameter by φ, and plate thickness by t, for example. Symbols may sometimes be omitted when the dimension-line direction or end marks make the meaning clear. Do not decide the dimension type solely because a symbol is not visible; check the feature and both ends of the dimension line. For example, R6 means radius 6 and φ6 means diameter 6; they do not specify the same shape.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Radius is indicated by R, diameter by φ, and plate thickness by t, for example. Symbols may sometimes be omitted when the dimension-line direction or end marks make the meaning clear. Do not decide the dimension type solely because a symbol is not visible; check the feature and both ends of the dimension line. For example, R6 means radius 6 and φ6 means diameter 6; they do not specify the same shape.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-04.stem: Electrostatic painting and electrodeposition painting mean exactly the same equipment and process.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Electrostatic painting uses forces due to electric charge; electrodeposition uses electricity in a bath. Their adhesion principles, equipment and processes are not identical.
False. Electrostatic painting uses forces due to electric charge; electrodeposition uses electricity in a bath. Their adhesion principles, equipment and processes are not identical.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-05.stem: In the contact CMM example, dimensions and other characteristics are evaluated from coordinates of probe contact positions; a hole-position result cannot be copied directly as an Ra roughness result.
reasons: True. CMM position and dimensional evaluation differs from the microscopic irregularities evaluated by a stylus roughness tester; check the specified parameters and conditions.
Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Coordinates and roughness parameters are different quantities, so the distinction requiring separate results is correct.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-06.stem: An outside micrometer holds the object between a screw-driven spindle and a fixed anvil.
reasons: True. An outside micrometer grips the object between the screw-driven spindle and the fixed anvil. Clean the measuring faces and check zero or the datum using a reference suitable for the range. Let the instrument and object acclimatize to the specified environment to reduce temperature effects. The textbook gives 20°C as the reference. Rushing to measure a hot product makes dimensional comparison inappropriate.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. An outside micrometer grips the object between the screw-driven spindle and the fixed anvil. Clean the measuring faces and check zero or the datum using a reference suitable for the range. Let the instrument and object acclimatize to the specified environment to reduce temperature effects. The textbook gives 20°C as the reference. Rushing to measure a hot product makes dimensional comparison inappropriate.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-07.stem: The material name “plastic” alone makes a product suitable as protective equipment for any electrical work.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Insulating performance depends on voltage, temperature, damage and other conditions. Do not substitute ordinary plastic products for specified protective equipment.
False. Insulating performance depends on voltage, temperature, damage and other conditions. Do not substitute ordinary plastic products for specified protective equipment.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-08.stem: A V-block helps support cylinders and similar objects, but simply placing a cylinder on it does not mean all its dimensions have been measured.
reasons: True. The V-groove helps support the object; dimensions are measured separately with a defined target, reference, instrument and method.
Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Supporting and reading dimensions have different roles; placement alone does not establish completed measurement.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-09.stem: Theory and practical sections are judged only by the combined correct-answer percentage, allowing a shortfall in one section to be offset.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Under this app’s practice conditions, theory requires at least 20/30 and practical at least 6/10 independently. A combined score does not compensate for a shortfall in either section.
False. Under this app’s practice conditions, theory requires at least 20/30 and practical at least 6/10 independently. A combined score does not compensate for a shortfall in either section.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-10.stem: Removing material during refinishing does not change component dimensions.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Removing material during refinishing changes dimensions. Check machining allowances and approved disposition.
False. Removing material during refinishing changes dimensions. Check machining allowances and approved disposition.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-11.stem: Where positive and negative deviations are given with a basic size, the upper value is the upper deviation and the lower value is the lower deviation.
reasons: True. A dimension has a permitted range; the difference between its upper and lower limits is the tolerance. In a display adding signed deviations to a nominal dimension, the upper entry is the upper deviation and the lower entry is the lower deviation. Add them with their signs to obtain limit dimensions. Do not treat the two numbers as unsigned magnitudes and add or subtract by appearance.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. A dimension has a permitted range; the difference between its upper and lower limits is the tolerance. In a display adding signed deviations to a nominal dimension, the upper entry is the upper deviation and the lower entry is the lower deviation. Add them with their signs to obtain limit dimensions. Do not treat the two numbers as unsigned magnitudes and add or subtract by appearance.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-12.stem: A KYT countermeasure can be made specific merely by saying “be more careful”.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Caution alone does not define the target, timing or checking method. Make causes and consequences specific and decide the action to perform.
False. Caution alone does not define the target, timing or checking method. Make causes and consequences specific and decide the action to perform.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-13.stem: For surface-texture specifications, check machining-related symbols, the target surface and measurement conditions rather than borrowing another surface’s value.
reasons: True. Surface condition affects machine performance and includes waviness and roughness. Drawings add a parameter such as Ra or Rz and its value to a symbol, indicating the relevant surface directly or with a leader line. The same number means something different with a different parameter. Do not reuse a value from another surface; also check the machining-related symbol, relevant surface and measurement conditions.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Surface condition affects machine performance and includes waviness and roughness. Drawings add a parameter such as Ra or Rz and its value to a symbol, indicating the relevant surface directly or with a leader line. The same number means something different with a different parameter. Do not reuse a value from another surface; also check the machining-related symbol, relevant surface and measurement conditions.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-14.stem: A semiconductor simply means a mixture of a conductor and an insulator.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Semiconductors are materials whose electrical properties under conditions such as temperature and light are utilized; they are not defined as simply mixing a conductor and an insulator.
False. Semiconductors are materials whose electrical properties under conditions such as temperature and light are utilized; they are not defined as simply mixing a conductor and an insulator.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-15.stem: Individual packaging helps protect and manage each item, while corrugated boxes group multiple items together.
reasons: True. Packaging protects products from scratches, dirt, moisture, and other hazards, communicates identification, and facilitates transport and storage. Individual wrapping supports separate protection and control; corrugated boxes group items together. Shrink film contracts under heat, but wrapping alone does not guarantee complete impact or moisture protection.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Packaging protects products from scratches, dirt, moisture, and other hazards, communicates identification, and facilitates transport and storage. Individual wrapping supports separate protection and control; corrugated boxes group items together. Shrink film contracts under heat, but wrapping alone does not guarantee complete impact or moisture protection.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-16.stem: If the two surfaces against which to place a protractor are unclear, show the drawing and ask; do not independently change to a different, easier-to-view surface.
reasons: True. Separate a request for an end length from a request for the angle of a sloping face. If the two reference faces are unclear, show the drawing and ask. Do not substitute an easier-to-see face. Record the instrument, target, contact faces and unit.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Separate a request for an end length from a request for the angle of a sloping face. If the two reference faces are unclear, show the drawing and ask. Do not substitute an easier-to-see face. Record the instrument, target, contact faces and unit.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-17.stem: A lathe mainly holds the workpiece stationary and cuts its outside diameter using only tool rotation, like a milling machine.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. A lathe mainly rotates the workpiece while a tool cuts its outside diameter and other features. A milling machine mainly rotates the tool to machine the workpiece.
False. A lathe mainly rotates the workpiece while a tool cuts its outside diameter and other features. A milling machine mainly rotates the tool to machine the workpiece.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-18.stem: Implementing one countermeasure invariably reduces residual risk to zero.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Hazards can remain after measures because of failures, misunderstandings, environmental changes and other factors. Check residual risks and new hazards.
False. Hazards can remain after measures because of failures, misunderstandings, environmental changes and other factors. Check residual risks and new hazards.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-19.stem: Rolling is plastic working that passes material between rolls and changes its shape by pressure, for example by reducing thickness.
reasons: True. Rolling is plastic forming in which material passes between rolls and pressure changes its shape, for example by reducing thickness. Hot rolling heats the material to make deformation easier; cold rolling is introduced here as processing without applied heating. Cold rolling still generates heat during work and does not mean “cold, therefore safe.” Check the process against required thickness, material, and temperature conditions.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Rolling is plastic forming in which material passes between rolls and pressure changes its shape, for example by reducing thickness. Hot rolling heats the material to make deformation easier; cold rolling is introduced here as processing without applied heating. Cold rolling still generates heat during work and does not mean “cold, therefore safe.” Check the process against required thickness, material, and temperature conditions.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-20.stem: For equipment requiring a grounding wire, check its connection and report defects to the responsible person.
reasons: True. Grounding is part of an equipment protection system and affects current paths during faults such as leakage. Where a grounding conductor is specified, check its connection and report defects. Do not describe grounding as preventing leakage itself or removing every electric-shock hazard.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Grounding is part of an equipment protection system and affects current paths during faults such as leakage. Where a grounding conductor is specified, check its connection and report defects. Do not describe grounding as preventing leakage itself or removing every electric-shock hazard.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-21.stem: “No entry” means entry is permitted if you are careful.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. No entry instructs people not to enter. It is not permission to enter carefully.
False. No entry instructs people not to enter. It is not permission to enter carefully.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-22.stem: Daily inspection checks specified items before starting work and at other designated times to detect small changes early.
reasons: True. Preventive maintenance is an approach to checking equipment condition to prevent failures and accidents, rather than only repairing it after a breakdown. Daily checks cover specified items before work and at other designated times to detect small changes early. Periodic inspections follow a plan and examine details that daily checks alone may not reveal. Performing one does not permit omission of the other.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Preventive maintenance is an approach to checking equipment condition to prevent failures and accidents, rather than only repairing it after a breakdown. Daily checks cover specified items before work and at other designated times to detect small changes early. Periodic inspections follow a plan and examine details that daily checks alone may not reveal. Performing one does not permit omission of the other.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-23.stem: A centerline is always a thick continuous line representing the component’s outline.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Visible outlines are generally thick continuous lines, while centers are normally thin chain lines with one dot. Do not confuse centerlines with outlines.
False. Visible outlines are generally thick continuous lines, while centers are normally thin chain lines with one dot. Do not confuse centerlines with outlines.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-24.stem: When inspection finds an incorrect material, share information including instructions, identification and handover rather than blaming only the inspector.
reasons: True. Quality is supported by the whole flow: translating customer requirements into design, procuring materials, manufacturing, inspecting and shipping. When inspection finds the wrong material, do not assume it is only the inspector’s failure. Share information about instructions, identification and handovers as well.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Quality is supported by the whole flow: translating customer requirements into design, procuring materials, manufacturing, inspecting and shipping. When inspection finds the wrong material, do not assume it is only the inspector’s failure. Share information about instructions, identification and handovers as well.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-25.stem: Missing the sleeve’s 0.5 mm indication on a micrometer does not change the result.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Missing the 0.5 mm half-millimeter indication changes the total by 0.5 mm. Read the sleeve including its last visible graduation.
False. Missing the 0.5 mm half-millimeter indication changes the total by 0.5 mm. Read the sleeve including its last visible graduation.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-26.stem: Tolerance is the sum of the maximum and minimum permissible sizes.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Tolerance is the difference obtained by subtracting the minimum permissible size from the maximum permissible size, not their sum.
False. Tolerance is the difference obtained by subtracting the minimum permissible size from the maximum permissible size, not their sum.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-27.stem: A caliper has outside and inside jaws and can also measure depth if it has a depth bar.
reasons: True. Calipers have outside and inside jaws; models with a depth bar also measure depth. Choose the correct measuring faces and check cleanliness, smooth movement, play, gaps when closed, and zero. Clean the workpiece too, and handle burrs using the approved method. Squeezing harder does not necessarily improve accuracy.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. Calipers have outside and inside jaws; models with a depth bar also measure depth. Choose the correct measuring faces and check cleanliness, smooth movement, play, gaps when closed, and zero. Clean the workpiece too, and handle burrs using the approved method. Squeezing harder does not necessarily improve accuracy.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-28.stem: Impact-test values can be compared unconditionally from the numbers alone even when temperatures or specimens differ.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. Absorbed energy is affected by specimen geometry, notches, temperature, method and other conditions. Align conditions for comparison.
False. Absorbed energy is affected by specimen geometry, notches, temperature, method and other conditions. Align conditions for comparison.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-29.stem: With a height gauge, check that the contact tip moves perpendicular to the reference plane and that the base and surface plate are free from foreign matter.
reasons: True. A height gauge is used on a surface plate to measure heights from that plane. Check that the measuring contact moves perpendicular to the reference face, and that the gauge base and plate have no foreign matter. Do not treat a tilted support as the same reference.

Choosing false for this statement is inappropriate. A height gauge is used on a surface plate to measure heights from that plane. Check that the measuring contact moves perpendicular to the reference face, and that the gauge base and plate have no foreign matter. Do not treat a tilted support as the same reference.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-theory-30.stem: A sectional view is a machining instruction to cut the actual object along that line.
reasons: Choosing true for this statement is inappropriate. A sectional view is a representation showing the interior through an imaginary cut. It is not a machining instruction to cut the actual object.
False. A sectional view is a representation showing the interior through an imaginary cut. It is not a machining instruction to cut the actual object.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-01.stem: After instruction, you can repeat numerical values but cannot explain stopping conditions. What is needed before working alone?
options: Ask about the stopping conditions, and have understanding and performance within the specified scope checked.
Start because the numbers alone are correct.
Hide questions and imitate a coworker.
Judge authorization solely by the number of demonstrations watched.
reasons: Have the instructor check your understanding, including stopping conditions, and your performance within the specified scope.
Being able to state numbers does not establish safety for independent work if abnormality-related stopping conditions remain unknown.
Hiding questions and imitating others leaves misunderstandings and unverified matters unresolved.
The number of times watched alone does not verify understanding, skill or the authorized scope of work.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-02.stem: Of 800 items in total, 80 were inspected and 4 were nonconforming. What is the percentage within the sample?
reasons: 4 ÷ 800 × 100 = 0.5% includes uninspected items in the denominator.
95% represents the 76 conforming items within the inspection sample.
Within the sample, 4 ÷ 80 × 100 = 5%. This does not mean every item in the lot has been checked.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-03.stem: The process sheet includes both quenching and tempering. What should be done after the desired hardness is achieved?
options: Check completion of the specified process including tempering and inspections.
Omit the remaining process if the item is hard.
Raise the temperature yourself to shorten the process.
reasons: Do not regard post-quenching hardness alone as completion; check through tempering and specified inspections.
Hardness alone does not verify toughness adjusted through tempering or completion of the entire process.
Tempering and annealing differ in purpose and conditions; do not substitute them without authorization.
Unauthorized changes to heating temperature compromise required properties and safety.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-04.stem: Streaks after rolling become slightly less noticeable when oil is increased. What should be done before closing the issue?
options: Close it based only on improved appearance.
Check and report supply, roll and material condition and the affected range.
reasons: Improved appearance does not guarantee elimination of the cause or completion of checks on affected items.
Unlimited increases depart from specified supply conditions and can create other problems.
Erasing process-status markings prevents identification of items awaiting post-treatment.
Do not attribute the cause solely to oil; record and report roll and material conditions and the affected range.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-05.stem: You found the front view in a basic third-angle projection layout. Where is the view from the right?
options: To the left of the front view.
To the right of the front view.
On the back of the paper.
Always only at the lower left of the drawing.
reasons: The left side is not the basic location of a right-side view in third-angle projection.
Third-angle projection places the view from the right to the right of the front view.
The back of the paper is not a location representing the basic projection-view arrangement.
Placement is based on direction relative to the principal view, not a fixed position at the drawing’s lower left.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-06.stem: You are asked to use another forklift model, but the applicability of your training is unclear. What should be checked before starting?
options: Only your experience of seeing a similar vehicle before.
Ask the responsible person about qualifications, training, applicable conditions and work authorization.
reasons: Experience of seeing a similar model alone does not verify the qualifications and training scope for this task.
Confirm with the responsible person that qualifications, training and work authorization fit the equipment conditions.
A mock-exam score grants no qualifications, training or authorization for actual work.
Speculation such as “probably” does not verify formal requirements or the authorized scope.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-07.stem: You turned off the operating switch before cleaning. What is needed before touching the interior?
options: It is unconditionally safe because the display went dark.
Replace every procedure with grounding alone.
Check isolation, residual energy and restart prevention using the equipment procedure.
Use your hand to check for electricity.
reasons: Even with the display off, energization paths, residual energy and other conditions remain unverified.
Grounding is one part of protection and does not replace isolation or restart prevention for internal cleaning.
Check the equipment-specific stopping, isolation, residual-energy and restart-prevention procedures.
Using the body to check for electricity itself creates an electric-shock hazard.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-08.stem: What is the nominal strain when a 60 mm gauge length reaches 61.2 mm?
reasons: Elongation is 1.2 mm and original length is 60 mm, so 1.2 ÷ 60 × 100 = 2%.
1.2 is the elongation in millimeters, not a percentage of original length.
102% is 61.2 ÷ 60 × 100, confusing the total-length ratio with the elongation percentage.
20% is ten times the correct 2%.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-09.stem: A scatter diagram appears to show a strong relationship between two quantities. Which subsequent conclusion is appropriate?
options: Erasing the data provides the same proof.
It is a clue to a relationship; causation requires separate verification.
reasons: A scatter-diagram relationship alone cannot prove causation.
Investigating causes requires checking other conditions, chronological relationships and other facts.
Erasing the source data also prevents tracing the evidence for the relationship.
A scatter diagram gives a clue to association; causation requires separate fact checking.

mfg1-mechanical-mock-04-practical-10.stem: Rolled items and post-treated items are mixed in the same location. Which response is appropriate?
options: Treat every item of correct thickness as finished.
Maintain process-status identification and verify completion against process sheets and inspections.
Standardize all status labels to one label.
reasons: Thickness conformity alone does not verify heat-treatment or surface-treatment requirements.
Presence or absence of oil does not indicate completion of heat or surface treatment.
Distinguish rolled and post-treated states and cross-check completion of process sheets and necessary inspections.
Standardizing labels for different states prevents distinguishing unfinished and finished items.
